final: WITH counts AS (SELECT a.link_to_member, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN member AS m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position), total AS (SELECT SUM(attendance_count) AS n FROM counts) SELECT c.link_to_member, c.position, c.attendance_count, CAST(c.attendance_count AS REAL) / t.n FROM counts AS c JOIN total AS t ON t.n IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 10
